name: Sukuenai Bokura
source:
The world was created by one deity.

This is the [unsalvable] story of the [unsalvable] who live in the [town]. A story about an ignorant hero gradually getting to know himself and his surroundings and presenting a [happy ending of his own] to the princess.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6381]NovelGame[/url]]
